notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional artifacts.
description:
Activate Breya by paying {2} and sacrificing two other artifacts, causing you to gain 5 life.
Sunbond triggers, putting five +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Animation Module triggers.
Holding priority, activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability three times by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {3}.
Resolve the Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token plus at least one additional artifact token due to Tippy-Toe.
Repeat.
